usedFor: A reply to an invitation in an AgentMail inbox becomes a Zoom webinar registration.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Received” in AgentMail, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: Inbound mail is the one trigger where a person is asking to join.

watchOut: AgentMail's bounce and spam complaint triggers also run this action and would register people who never asked.
